summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of 4 new booking features (Table Booking, Tiffin, Pickup Orders, Catering) completed successfully. All features properly support region-aware logic (India INR vs Perth/Australia AUD) with complete WhatsApp integration flows.
critical_code_review_comments: All 4 booking pages use well-structured data-driven JSON config files for menus, centers, packages, and booking rules
Proper use of data-testid attributes for automated testing
WhatsApp URL generation uses correct encoding (encodeURIComponent) for message text
seed_data_creation: Static JSON config files: centers.json (8 locations), menus-india.json, menus-perth.json, booking-rules.json, catering-packages.json, tiffin-config.json
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 booking features are fully functional with WhatsApp integration. Config data is loaded from JSON files, no backend APIs involved.
